lines.en: I make my way through an empty lobby and out into the open air.
It’s not every day that I go to the effort of seeking someone out for the sole purpose of doing something nice for them, but...tis the season or whatever else you’re supposed to say here.
What a life I lead where I must justify acts of kindness with seasonal phrases at the risk of seeming a little more human to whoever or whatever is watching me at all hours of the day.
Or night now, I suppose.
Which isn’t to say that someone is watching me.
I’m no more paranoid than anyone else.
But, in the event that one of thousands of religions might have sturdy enough hands to grab hold of the elusive truths of the world- I will remain careful.
I will remain vigilant.
Because those elusive truths would imply that there is more to simply being than being.
I will walk into the night with a purpose in every step, keeping close to the walls to avoid the prying eyes of imaginary (Or unimaginary) gods.
Or...anyone else who might see me alone with a small girl in the middle of the night.
I’m sure I look incredibly suspicious right now.
But I’m an incredibly suspicious person, so that’s rightfully deserved.
I look down at the stuffed bear in my hands and wonder why it was that I picked this of all things.
Was this really just a spur of the moment decision brought on by an overwhelming lack of care?
Or is there something more to it?
I search my mind for the answer but am unable to sneak past an ever-growing wall of apathy thirty one years in the making.
To think it’s been in construction for so long and is not even close to finished is a bit disheartening.
And while I should hate that such an obstacle exists at all, especially in the place where it does-
All I’m really curious about is whether or not I’ll live to see it completed.
What a wonderful wall it will be.
Oh, right.
The bear.
I need to give this to Miku.
My legs begin to tremble for reasons beyond my comprehension.
The glow of electric billboards dyes my clothes.
I revel in the light, yet move further into the dark in hopes of pulling out a girl drenched in it.
I find her on a familiar bench in a familiar place.
I find her easily.
She does not notice my presence at first, for I am just one more shadow in a world filled to the brim with them.
I do not exist until she accepts my existence.
And I make no sound because there are no sounds left to make.
Her shirt comes off, but only in my mind.
I’m sure that things are different outside of it.
They always are.
As I sit stand and stare at the budding chest of the school’s star soccer player, I struggle to subconsciously slide off her pants.
How shameful that even the images I conjure up are incapable of giving me more than I already have.
Or had.
Or will have.
Or am currently having.
Or possessed at one point only to be pushed back to the beginning.
But for what?
The sensation of flower petals falling off of my fingertips infuriates me.
I long to return to the memory of this young girl, nervously grinding up against my-
No.
That’s not why I-
I wonder how often she thinks of that night.
I bet it’s more than I do.
: Hm?
: Sensei?
: Hey.
: What’re you doin’ out here? Figured you’d be fist deep in a whole room full of girls by now.
: I think you might be misunderstanding the usage of “fist deep” seeing as I only have two of them and could not possibly-
: Actually, that doesn’t matter. I’m here to see you.
: Me? But...Wait, did Makoto tell you I was here?
: Was she not supposed to do that?
: Well, I...didn’t tell her not to tell ya. I just think there are a lot better ways of spendin’ your Christmas than worrying about me.
: I’ll go back up soon. Just needed a little break from all of the noise.
: Turns out I wasn't doin' as good as I thought I was.
: Can only handle so much at once, ya know?
: Don’t worry about rushing to go back up there. Almost half of the class is missing at this point, so it’s not like you’re the odd man out or anything.
: Yeah, I noticed that. And Kirin left without even sayin’ bye to me. D’ya think havin’ so many people in our class now is like...separatin’ everybody into factions or something?
: No, but I wouldn’t be surprised if the two day long event where you all literally separated into factions did that.
: Don’t bring that up. I’m still embarrassed about how my part of the contest ended up.
: You...won, though?
: But at what cost?! It wasn’t a sweep and I got licked by a girl! It may as well have just been a flat out loss.
: Then...make up for it next time. I don’t know.
: You feelin’ okay, Sensei? You look fine but you seem a little more...blah than usual.
: Anything your buddy Miku can do to perk you up a bit?
: Nothing legal.
: Legal? You tryin’ to rob a bank or something?
: Yup. That is exactly what I was implying.
: Then take a seat and draft up some heist plans with me. I had to use up the last of my money buyin’ a present for Io so I’m basically flat out broke.
: You had to get something for Io? What did you buy?
: Hehehe...I ain’t tellin’ you. You’ll just have to see it for yourself the next time you visit her room.
: Now, come on. Tell me more about this heist. Me and you’ll be the best bank robbers Kumon-mi’s ever seen.
Miku slides over on the bench and makes room for me.
I awkwardly place the stuffed bear in my lap and have to choke back vomit as it causes me to imagine a life in which it is replaced by a child.
And while I’m sure the image of that would make several girls I know very, very happy- it makes me feel sick.
: I ain’t gonna lie to you, Sensei...you look pretty friggin’ creepy right now. Kinda like some...baby thief or something.
: I’m glad that at least you acknowledge that I would be a horrible father. That means a lot.
: Wasn’t really tryin’ to compliment you, but I’m glad I could help.
: What’re ya carryin’ that thing around for anyway? I wasn’t gonna say anything at first, but now that it’s in your lap, I kinda can’t ignore it anymore.
: Wait, isn’t that the same bear Touka was luggin’ around earlier? She give that to you or something?
: I know ya told me I wasn't supposed to look at her, but I kinda failed at that right away.
: Pretty crappy present if ya ask me.
: Well, that is going to make the next few minutes very awkward because I actually bought this for you.
: No. No you didn’t. That’s...
: That’s not something that...
: Because...I’m...
Guess I should have just added another piece to her soccer ball collection after all.
: If you’re worried about upsetting me, don’t be. It’s fine to dislike it.
: I kind of just bought it on a whim anyway, so it’s not like there was any real thought put into it.
: You bought...that on a whim...for me?
: You’re just pullin’ my leg, right? You probably bought that for Ami or Uta or somethin’ and are just messin’ around right now.
: Why would I be messing around?
: Because that’s definitely not the kinda thing I’d expect ya to buy for me when you can get some kinda...sports thingy at pretty much any store you walk into!
: I don’t have anything that...girly! I just don’t keep that kind of stuff around! So you’d have no reason to choose that over somethin’ more...Miku-ish.
: Well, it’s yours now. So if you want to pretend it’s a basketball and just shoot it into the trash can behind us, we can do that.
: I get to go first, though, because I used my money to buy it and that would only be fair.
: What? No...I...
Miku snatches the bear out of my hands and stares at it for a few moments.
I recall a short while ago when Makoto mentioned something about Miku going to the place “furthest away from the noise” or however it was she worded it-
But the lack of conversation, as temporary as it may be, makes me acutely aware that there is no escape at all.
And that even in this place, as far away from her fears as possible, they’re still lingering in the background.
As is everything in a world full of shadows.
: So, remember when you said I was creepy a couple minutes ago? You’re really not making a good case for yourself by just silently staring at a toy right now.
: Oh no...
: Miku?
: No no no no no no...this is bad.
: This is really, really bad.
: Wow. You must really hate bears.
: This is the single worst thing you could have gotten me...
: Yeah, you’ve made that pretty apparent.
: No...Sensei...You don’t understand...
: I love it...
: You’re right. I don’t understand.
: I love it so much! I...I need to give him a name!
: You really don’t-
: I do!
: And...
: And...
: I’m sorry!
: Sorry for-
: Mm~
Oh. Okay.
I get it now.
It’s exactly what she wanted.
Perhaps there was a reason I bought this after all.
And perhaps things simply stop being whims when you’ve existed long enough to experience every outcome.
Is this a new path?
Or am I just sticking as close to someone else’s shadow as I possibly can?
There’s obviously no point in thinking about that right now, though.
Not when I can do this.
: Mm! Mm...mnh...mm...
: Chu...mm~
: Thank you...mnch...thank...you...
: Sensei...
Miku clumsily kisses me back and clearly has no idea what she’s doing.
She likes it, though.
Which, all things considered, I’m not that surprised about.
I’ve obviously known for a while that she’s been interested in me on at least some level.
I just figured that level was going to remain a bit more dubious until she came to terms with pining after the man her best friend loves.
That’s why this present was so horrible.
Because it’s jeopardizing one of the purest, truest friendships I have ever known.
And it’s doing so in a way much more calculated than drowsily grinding against my cock in the middle of the night.
This is something we meant to do.
No. This is something Miku meant to do.
She can’t hide anymore.
There truly is no escape.
: Haah...
: I have to tell Makoto...
: Why?
: Because she loves you...
: Makoto must know how you feel about me by now.
: I don't know, Sensei. She did bust into the room that one time, but...
: But I told her it didn't mean anything. I promised her it didn't mean anything.
: Stop suffering for her.
: It’s not suffering, Sensei. If she’s happy, I’m happy.
: Then shouldn’t the same go for her?
: What do you mean?...
: If being with me makes you happy, shouldn’t she be happy knowing that you are?
: She’s liked you forever. I can’t just cut the line no matter how much I want to.
: But you can blur it.
: You’ve gotta remember who you’re talkin’ to right now, Sensei. I ain’t good at pickin’ up on fancy metaphors like that.
: That...was a metaphor, right?
: Just keep this a secret. You don’t have to tell Makoto everything because there’s no way she’s telling you everything.
: She does, though...
: But that’s not sayin’ I like hearin’ it...It’s really hard sometimes, you know?...
: I’m happy that she gets to...do all sorts of stuff with you...but it makes me feel all...gross inside hearin’ about it...
: And your solution is to just keep letting that happen?
: I told you already...I’m on Team Makoto...
: I can’t be-
: Mmm! Mm...
: I...can’t be...mnch...doing this...
: It’s bad...it’s...really...really...bad...
: You seem to be enjoying this quite a bit for someone who allegedly doesn’t want it.
: I doubt you’re havin’ any fun, though. I’ve got no friggin’ idea what to do with my tongue. I’m still new to this.
: That’s fine. We can practice.
: I’ve gotta tell her, Sensei...
: You don’t.
: I do...
: You don’t.
: I do. Every time I look at that bear, it’s gonna remind me of this.
: Then get rid of the bear.
: You kidding?! No way! This is the first time anyone’s ever given me somethin’ like that! And it was friggin’ you of all people.
: I’m gonna treasure it forever!
: Then don’t complain about how it makes you feel when you look at it.
: Accept what happened here tonight and take solace in the fact that the person you’re interested in is interested in you.
: Makoto doesn’t need to know that. No one does.
: Sensei...thank you again for the present, but...
: I kinda...think I need a little time to myself to...figure out what to do.
: I’m assuming that means we’re done making out then?
: I guess so...
: Sorry again for attacking you like that...
: You can attack me as often as you want so long as we’re not in public.
: Stop sayin’ such...dangerous things, Sensei...
: It’ll only make it harder for me...
Miku and I break apart.
But she breaks a little bit more.
Welcome to Lessons in Love!
A game where you get to put your penis inside of girls dealing with trauma, no matter how bad of an idea they may think it is!
Occasionally, your actions will cause things like this to happen.
But that’s okay! Because, most of the time, it won’t even be your fault.
You are a shadow, after all.
You are everything I want you to be.
And slowly, but surely, you are becoming even more.
There is something buried underneath your feet.
And something above as well.
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
